jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.  

  

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  

  

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise\-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.


#### **The Role**



Global Seller Onboarding Specialistsmanage the final stages of the sales funnel, working with US merchants to drive the deal through to activation and accelerate the onboarding process. Global Seller Onboarding Specialists use deep product and industry knowledge to project\-manage the onboarding stage of the sales process. They’ll be responsible for and guiding sellers through the discovery and onboarding journey and ensuring that sellers are optimally scoped, educated, set up and trained to leverage the potential of Square’s platform. They are additionally instrumental in ensuring the documentation and tracking of feature requests to inform future product roadmaps. This is a customer\-facing role that involves a combination of remote and onsite merchant interactions.



A successful Implementation Specialists will: (1\) provide an incredible onboarding experience for Sellers, (2\) accelerate the sales cycle by specialising onboarding and training, (3\) develop new efficiencies to shorten the onboarding sales stage, and (4\) support Square’s international expansion efforts.


* "Global Seller Onboarding Specialists manage the final stages of the sales funnel, working with US merchants to drive the deal through to activation and accelerate the onboarding process."
* "Looking for willingness to travel as part of the job (around 10%) and most likely majority of the onsites will be in and around New York/NY.

#### **You Will**


* Drive world\-class onboarding and implementation experiences for Square’s sellers, ensuring accountability to go\-live timelines and accelerating deal velocity wherever possible.
* Cultivate strong cross\-functional relationships with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to align on the seller journey, remove barriers, and deliver faster outcomes.
* Anticipate and resolve obstacles by managing stakeholder communications and developing scalable strategies that drive consistent success.  

Master Square’s platform, products, integrations, and ecosystem, staying ahead of new features and releases to serve as a trusted subject\-matter expert.
* Lead high\-impact, multi\-merchant projects with competing priorities, ensuring effective resource allocation and timely delivery.
* Create and maintain engaging training materials for both internal teams and external partners.
* Execute accurate data entry and migration tasks for select sellers as part of the onboarding process.

* BA/BS degree, preferably
* 2\-3 years of experience in a customer facing role, preferably in software implementation, support, sales/account management or customer success.
* An infectiously positive attitude, as well as a desire to perform at a high level on a continuous basis, and uplift the team around you.
* Bias for action; performance driven with the confidence to operate independently.
* Ability to thrive within ambiguity and operate independently.
* Ability to drive and manage multiple cross\-functional initiatives simultaneously; strong time management, and excellent written \& verbal communication skills.
* Proven track record of success in delivering multiple complex projects in the technology industry while partnering with external and internal clients to attain deliverables.
* An ability to learn quickly as new products and organisational changes are released.
* Previous Project Management experience is expected.
* Experience in the POS, Payments or Tech industries is a plus.
* Experience in hardware installation and network configuration is a plus.
* Located in PST or MST time zone.


**Your typical day will include:**


* Remote merchant work: virtual consultation calls and training, advising on hardware/software/operations, staff training, menu building, and hardware installation.
* Occasional onsite merchant work, including training and hardware install.
* Data Entry: configure customer account, optimise menu setup, and other data entry tasks involved in getting a merchant onboard.

* Paid parental leave
* Paid time off

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist 2, Catholic
jobs.description:
**About the Role**



The Implementation Specialist II will manage the onboarding of customers in all segments by successfully implementing the Pushpay product suite. The right individual provides a distinctive post sale service that makes Pushpay the market leader and preferred choice for digital giving in the non\-profit space. This individual possesses a passion for customer satisfaction, obsession for accuracy, a blend of technical and customer\-interaction skills, a drive for excellence, can effectively navigate objections, and has what it takes to deliver results.

  


*Named as one of BuiltIn '****Best Places to Work****' in Seattle, Denver and Dallas for 2025; ranked number* ***10*** *by Seattle Business Magazine in the '****Washington's 100 Best Companies to Work For'*** *list in the large companies category for 2024; named as a 2025 '****Best Places to Work for Women'*** *by Best Companies Group.*

  


**Benefits and Compensation**



We have a passion for making all employees feel supported. In addition to having a genuine interest in helping you do your best work and drive your career, we offer:


* 100% employer\-paid premiums for Medical HDHP Plan, Dental, and Vision for employee
* 70% employer\-paid premiums for Medical PPO Plan for employees, and Medical, Dental, and Vision for dependents
* 401K match
* Hybrid work model \- 3 days in the COS office / 2 days remote
* Remote work for approved states
* 12 paid company holidays
* 2 paid Volunteer Time Off days
* 15 days PTO to start, increases with tenure and seniority
* Paid parental and adoption leave
* **Compensation Range:** **$67,500\-$78,489**


*Compensation ranges are determined by role and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the pay range for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.*


**The following states are approved as remote work locations for this position: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA \- All other states are not in consideration for this role at this time.**

  


**What You'll Do**


* Project manage the onboarding and implementation of Catholic customers, manage a pipeline, and meet or exceed KPI's.
* Become an expert in the Pushpay product suite and set appropriate expectations with the customer.
* Deliver results, provide high quality customer interactions, drive product adoption, and effectively manage multiple/simultaneous implementations.
* Coordinate with Product, Service Delivery, and Customer Success teams to execute on implementation.
* Build and effectively execute account plans and strategies unique to each account.
* Regularly review assigned accounts to highlight key results, analyze metrics, demonstrate value, and emphasize the ROI, as well as, recommend process/procedure changes to better utilize Pushpay services.
* Help develop existing customer relationships with the company; in\-line with the company service process and ensure maximum customer retention is achieved.
* Maintain knowledge of market conditions and competitive activities.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual goals and provide accurate, timely reports and forecasts as needed for management.
* Receive direction from the VP, Director of Implementation, and guidance from Customer Success Team Leads.

  


**What You'll Bring**


* BA/BS Degree
* 3\+ years of working in SaaS onboarding and implementation, or as a Customer Success Manager.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to identify, critique, suggest, and implement intelligent changes to the clients and business optimization processes.
* Strong problem resolution skills \- proven ability to engage and interact with internal teams to resolve client issues.
* Desire to work in a startup environment, with proactive mindset and minimum need for supervision.
* Experience with CRM software (e.g. Salesforce).
* Ability to prioritize and manage workload to meet deadlines.
* Ability to manage multiple, concurrent client relationships.
* Well\-organized and strong work ethic.
* Ability to anticipate change and adjust priorities accordingly.
* Understanding of key drivers of success for Catholic parishes.
* Understanding of industry culture, products, and services.
* Excellent eye for detail – ability to create accurate and high quality pieces of work.
* Not required: Bilingual in Spanish; ability to translate verbal and written communication, and speak to customers in Spanish.

  



Pushpay is committed to equal opportunity. We value and embrace diversity and inclusion of all Team Members. Pushpay uses E\-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. Head to our career page to learn more.



If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, or you require religious accommodation, and you wish to discuss potential accommodations related to applying for employment at Pushpay, please contact peopleteam@pushpay.com.


**About** **Pushpay**

Pushpay helps organizations and communities come to gather \& stay connected, strengthening community, connection, and belonging through our suite of mobile apps, management software, and giving technology. Our 550 Pushpay teammates support 10,000\+ customers as they drive social good, and we're honored to have processed over $15 billion in charitable giving. We're growing fast, including some exciting acquisitions in recent years, and we need driven talent. Join Pushpay and grow with us!

jobs.description:
Location

Position Type
Regular Full Time
Salary
$19\.00 \- $20\.00 an hour

Description
**Welcome to Goodwill!**
Goodwill of Central North Carolina’s mission is to improve lives and enrich communities through the power of work! Thanks to our Retail Stores and Donation Centers, we break down the barriers to employment and help people achieve their job and career goals through training, support, and career readiness resources. Our values are the backbone of our diverse and inclusive organization.


*If you want to be part of a team that makes a difference – Goodwill is for you!*


**What You’ll Do:**


* The **Retail Training Specialist** provides individual and small group training to a diverse employee population. This requires the ability to develop curriculum and training plans, and facilitate coaching and training in a variety of settings.
* Provide operational training to new hire personnel, including orientation and onboarding, and other assigned team members in accordance with established guidelines in standard operating procedures.
* Responsible for creating a motivating learning environment, assessing and tracking student progress and modifying approach/supports as needed for successful skill mastery.
* Support progress on team member development plans and actively coordinates training opportunities for individuals’ improved performance and career development.
* Schedule and coordinate continued training and mentoring for personnel, providing continued support and guidance to trainees, managers, and mentors.
* Regularly travel to sites to coach trainees on assigned tasks and training curriculum.
* Stay current on all business updates; policy changes, software updates, price changes, procedural updates and changes, production quota updates, new forms, etc.; communicating changes and training personnel promptly and thoroughly to ensure seamless transitions and full understanding throughout the team.
* Utilize recommendations and observations from customer/donor surveys, assessments, floor walks, audits and secret shops to prioritize site needs, further develop individual and team members skills and enhance the retail experience for all stakeholders.

* 

**Education, Experience, and Skills that are a must:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in retail settings, preferably in management roles. Strong knowledge of retail practices, inventory control, and exceptional customer service skills required.
* Minimum of 2 years of formal experience in training and/or instruction, including the development and delivery of training curriculum to diverse populations.
* Must have a valid NC driver’s license, acceptable driving record, reliable personal vehicle, adequate vehicle insurance coverage, and ability to travel locally on a daily basis.
* Sufficient knowledge of bookkeeping and accounting procedures to understand sales reports incidental to store operations, processing information and merchandise through computer systems and POS register system.
* Excellent computer skills and expertise with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, \& PowerPoint).
* Comfortable and effective at handling customers and situations without input from others and in alignment with organizational mission, values, and philosophies.
* Due to the nature of the position as a front\-line trainer, successful candidates must demonstrate the ability to be creative, self\-sufficient, and proactive, with excellent critical thinking and problem\-solving skills; ability to work alone, multi\-task, and juggle competing priorities. Flexibility and responsiveness to frequent change is critical in this role.
* Must have a good command of written and spoken English, including good grammar (Bi\-lingual in Spanish is strongly preferred).
* Must successfully pass pre\-employment drug and background screens.

**Pay Range \& Schedule:**

* This position is hourly/non\-exempt. Wage is $19\-$20 per hour, based on qualification/experience.
* Position is full\-time. Work is generally conducted Monday\-Friday, 8:00am\-4:30pm, with regular requirements for evening and/or weekend support.
* Position is located at our Home Office in Greensboro, NC, with daily travel throughout our 5\-county service footprint including Alamance, Caswell, Guilford, Randolph, and Rockingham Counties. Minimal remote work may be available at a future date based on performance.

**Perks of the Job:**


* We provide an extensive benefits package for our team members that covers health care (medical, telehealth, dental, and vision), company paid life insurance, supplemental insurances (accident, cancer, disability, \& critical illness), legal support, ID protection, and pet insurance.
* Additionally, our financial benefits include an employee discount, paid time off (PTO), 12 paid holidays, a 401(k) plan with employer matched contributions of 100% of first 5% you contribute, quarterly performance\-based bonuses, paid training, employee referral bonuses, and an education assistance program of $4,000 annually. (Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.)

jobs.description:
**Location**: This is a hybrid remote/in\-office role.

***Medidata follows a hybrid office policy in which employees who are hired for an in\-person position are expected to work on site a certain number of days per week following Company policy.***

**About our Company**:


Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. Celebrating over 25 years of ground\-breaking technological innovation across more than 38,000 trials and 12 million patients, Medidata offers industry\-leading expertise, analytics\-powered insights, and one of the largest clinical trial data sets in the industry. More than 1 million registered users across approximately 2,300 customers trust Medidata's seamless, end\-to\-end platform to improve patient experiences, accelerate clinical breakthroughs, and bring therapies to market faster. A Dassault Systèmes brand (Euronext Paris: FR0014003TT8, DSY.PA), Medidata is headquartered in New York City and has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group and IDC. Discover more at www.medidata.com. Listen to our latest podcast, from Dreamers to Disruptors, and follow us at @Medidata.

**About the Team**:


Implementation Consultants (ICs) help ensure that Medidata's software applications are implemented or enabled in accordance with Medidata standard business processes, meet client requirements and adhere to Good Clinical Data Management Practices. ICs also consult with our clients, provide guidance and make suggestions on how to best implement Medidata's software to provide the most value.


The ICs work with Project Managers and other functional departments during the implementation or enablement of Medidata's software applications, in addition to helping in the training, education and mentoring of colleagues.

**Responsibilities**:

* Lead configuration or enable customers on Medidata software to translate customer needs and meet customer requirements.
* Adhere to or educate on best practices for implementing Medidata's software
* Author, adapt, or agree on specifications based upon client requirements. This can include functional test cases for use in configuring and developing solutions in Medidata's suite of products, as well as in custom integrations.
* Support less experienced team members with client engagements, being accountable for quality of delivery.
* Support developers and other cross functional departments during configuration or implementation of specifications.
* Support cross functional departments with issue resolution.
* Delivery of in\-person/remote client workshops.
* Work to Project Management timelines and budgets, ensuring timely completion of deliverables within the agreed scope of work.
* Support customers during enablement or implementation of our software by answering questions, resolving configuration or UAT issues, and providing guidance on software usage.
* Adhere to industry data collection and handling standards to ensure consistency and facilitate downstream processing (e.g., QC testing).
* Communicate status reports to stakeholders on both client and internal projects.
* Participate in and lead internal initiatives, e.g., process improvement, product improvement, and identifying best practices.
* Comply with and enforce Medidata Standard Operating Procedures, processes and policies.
* Assist in the scheduling of professional services resources and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Support Training Group in preparation of course materials and delivery of courses both internally and externally as needed.
* Support third party vendors with integration and/or data transfer efforts.
* Own multiple customer\-facing projects or engagements.
* Significant knowledge and experience in one product or solution, or, relevant experience in a group of products/solutions.
* Mentor/Train AICs or new employees.

**Qualifications**:

* Industry knowledge of Clinical Trial processes, specifically as they relate to data collection, standards, management, and preparation for statistical analysis
* Strong understanding of those associated specifications, and ability to translate them into clinical systems solutions
* Ability to work with technical R\&D staff and translate new software features into real world examples
* Knowledge of computer usage in a web\-based environment
* Ability to absorb and apply new information quickly
* Ability to think logically to solve complex problems
* Solid analytical and technical skills with regard to software applications
* Strong collaboration and team\-building skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Self\-motivated, able to assume responsibility and work autonomously in a professional manner
* Experience of working to Standard Operating Procedures
* Adaptable to changing business needs and/or product landscapes
* Willing to travel to office locations and customer engagements
* Minimum 4\-year university/college degree or equivalent (analytic discipline a plus)
* Experience working with clinical trials, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Prior services delivery experience required
* Experience supporting project teams and meeting project timelines
* Prior data management or clinical trial software consulting experience preferred.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist II - RCM- Salt Lake City, Utah
jobs.description:
Kipu is bettering the behavioral health landscape, helping treatment centers achieve the best outcomes and empowering patients and caregivers on every step of the recovery journey. Join us in our work to advance behavioral health care in our communities. Our innovative solutions support providers in treating addiction, eating disorders, and many other behavioral health conditions. Our EMR, CRM, and revenue cycle solutions help behavioral health facilities succeed in managing their patients' entire care journey, but it is through our people that we truly make a difference.

**Role Overview**


The Implementation Specialist II, RCM independently owns end\-to\-end implementations for behavioral health treatment centers on the Kipu RCM platform. You will lead discovery, translate billing and revenue cycle requirements into configuration decisions, train end users, and drive accountability for timelines and deliverables. This role operates with minimal oversight and contributes to team quality through mentorship and process improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Discovery \& Solution Design**

* Lead discovery conversations to identify client billing workflows, payer mix, compliance requirements, and constraints.
* Translate client requirements into clear, actionable RCM configuration decisions aligned with best practices.
* Challenge misaligned or risky requests respectfully, explaining tradeoffs and downstream billing impacts.

**Configuration \& Data Quality**

* Configure billing workflows, payer rules, fee schedules, and system settings accurately on the first pass.
* Troubleshoot RCM configuration issues by identifying root causes rather than treating symptoms.
* Validate billing data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before go\-live.

**Client Training \& Adoption**

* Deliver structured, goal\-oriented training that prepares clients to manage billing workflows independently.
* Equip client administrators to train their own teams on billing processes and system usage.
* Drive client accountability for tasks, timelines, and data deliverables.

**Project Delivery \& Risk Management**

* Own project documentation, ensuring records and project plans reflect reality.
* Identify risks early and document them with clear descriptions, owners, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional partners when scope, risk, or complexity warrants it.

**Go\-Live Readiness \& Adoption**

* Prepare clients for go\-live by validating that all billing readiness criteria are genuinely met.
* Support post\-go\-live adoption by tracking billing accuracy, claim submission rates, and early revenue cycle health.
* Contribute to process improvements and share learnings with peers and newer team members.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2\-4 years of experience implementing an RCM system, or a combination of RCM implementation and technical support.
* 6\+ years of revenue cycle management experience.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to lead structured client meetings and drive decisions.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing timelines.

**Preferred**

* Experience in behavioral health, mental health, or addiction treatment settings.
* Familiarity with EDI, ERA, clearinghouse processes, and payer enrollment workflows.
* Experience mentoring or supporting newer team members.

**Benefits \& Compensation**

* Flexible paid time off.
* 11 Paid Holidays.
* Health, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance.
* Parental Leave.
* Pet Insurance.
* 401(K) with Company Match.

**Kipu Promise**


In an environment of rapid change, millions are struggling to cope. Kipu is here to help. Having shaped the industry for 10 years, today we focus on advancing our New Vision for the behavioral health ecosystem, evolving how it operates, interacts, communicates, and heals.


We are an equal opportunity employer and highly value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, gender identity, or disability status.

Description:
***RN \- Implementation Specialist***

**Job Summary:**


Responsible for applications training, electronic health records (EHR) training, onsite support for staff and provider use of hospital\-based clinical information systems. Onsite support includes initial clinical systems training and ongoing support. This position supports hospital’s strategic use of data to improve clinical, operational, financial and quality outcomes. It serves as a bridge between information technology, clinical operations and leadership by managing data conversion projects, developing reports and dashboards, conducting data analysis and supporting EHR optimization initiatives.

**Essential Functions:**

* Provides initial and ongoing training to providers and staff on hospital applications, including EMR
* Collects input from care providers required for design and development of clinical information systems and collaborates in the design, build, analysis and improvement of clinical information systems
* Assists with data transfer assignments between the hospital and other entities.
* Assists with data mining and queries to write reports or data extractions to support all departments. Assignment includes the development and maintenance of departmental dashboards
* Ensure that the hospital achieves Meaningful Use targets, including communicating to relevant departments their progress in achieving Meaningful Use goals and assisting with the process to achieve the goals
* Participates in organization committees to share information about clinical user practices, needs and requirements. Facilitate communication with other support staff to respond to questions or provide additional support to care providers
* Communicates changes and/or new information, including EHR upgrades, in a timely and appropriate manner
* Work collaboratively with the other IT staff, providing limited technical support to clinical users and facilitate communication with technical resources when more advanced technical assistance is required.
* Prepares reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using tools such as Tableau and other tools.
* Conduct clinical system demonstrations as requested by organizational committees
* Enhance clinical user satisfaction by developing expanded and coordinated approaches to service delivery to care providers.
* Support application implementation, troubleshooting, and day\-to\-day system support activities.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**


Job Description
Qualifacts is a leading provider of behavioral health software and SaaS solutions for clinical productivity, compliance and state reporting, billing, and business intelligence. Its mission is to be an innovative and trusted technology and end\-to\-end solutions partner, enabling exceptional outcomes for its customers and those they serve. Qualifacts’ comprehensive portfolio, including the CareLogic®, Credible™, and InSync® platforms, spans and serves the entire behavioral health, rehabilitative, and human services market supporting non\-profit Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHC) as well as for\-profit large enterprise and small business providers. Qualifacts has a loyal customer base, with more than 2,500 customers representing 75,000 providers serving more than 6 million patients. Qualifacts was recognized in the 2022 and 2023 Best in KLAS: Software and Services report as having the top ranked Behavioral Health EHR solutions.


If you want to work inside an atmosphere where innovation has purpose, and your ambition works to support our customers and those they serve, please apply today!

**We are seeking candidates in Nashville or Tampa to work a hybrid schedule in either office location. Remote candidates will not be considered.**

**Summary of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**


We are seeking a Clinical Implementation Specialist to join our team and play a critical role in guiding new customers through the entire implementation lifecycle of our healthcare technology solutions. This position requires a blend of clinical expertise, technical knowledge, and exceptional communication skills to ensure successful adoption and compliance with state and reporting requirements.

**Responsibilities for the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Assess clinical practices, state reporting, and patient treatment requirements; develop collaborative solutions and present recommendations
* Lead new customer implementations from kickoff through go\-live, ensuring a smooth and efficient process
* Resolve client inquiries promptly, maintaining ownership through resolution
* Maintain project documentation and communicate updates via agendas, minutes, and project management tools
* Build and sustain positive, productive relationships with customers and internal teams
* Apply consultative techniques to identify configuration requirements and implement best practices
* Review and validate software configurations with customer implementation teams
* Ensure quality of configured features and prepare customers for effective end\-user training
* Complete product training and demonstrate adaptability across multiple EHR platforms
* Creatively resolve and assess a wide range of issues, suggesting alternative approaches as needed
* Document and track all customer state and reporting requirements to ensure compliance
* Record all customer interactions in CRM according to established standards
* Participate in on\-site visits as needed to gather data and understand workflows

**Qualifications of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
* Clinical experience in behavioral health or general healthcare
* SaaS/cloud implementation experience; EHR/EMR experience preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Strong remote collaboration skills
* Data visualization and reporting analysis expertise
* Familiarity with CCBHC and state\-specific clinical requirements (NY or CA preferred)
* Knowledge of HIPAA compliance
* Exceptional customer service and communication skills (written \& oral)
* Quick, logical problem\-solving with attention to detail and follow\-through
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Ability to travel up to 25%

Qualifacts is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
**Minimum Qualifications:**


Bachelor’s degree in a related field and one (1\) year of related experience. Must possess sufficient educational background and/or experience to perform clinical applications analysis or programming. An equivalent combination of education and experience relevant to the role may be considered for this position.

  



**Preferred Qualifications:**


Having participated in a relevant fellowship program and/or one (1\) year of IS experience.

  



**Job Summary:**


This position is responsible for the design, configuration, implementation, maintenance, and support of clinical applications of basic to medium complexity. Clinical applications include any software application used in support of the clinical enterprise, including patient registration, patient billing, clinical documentation utilized in the ambulatory and inpatient settings, as well as applications for specific medical specialties such as, but not limited to, Radiology, Pathology, Oncology, Transplant, and Cardiology. Other responsibilities include providing basic to intermediate analysis and documentation of business and management problems to formulate clinical application requirements. Assists in providing solutions to routine problems utilizing more efficient operational procedures, workflows, and technology solutions.

 **Job Duties:**


An entry\-level Medical Device Integration (MDI) position plays a crucial role in ensuring seamless data flow between medical devices and our Epic EMR. This position involves assisting with the installation, configuration, and maintenance of integration engines (Capsule) and device interfaces.

 **Key duties include:**

* Troubleshooting connectivity issues
* Performing routine system checks
* Documenting integration processes
* Collaborating with clinical and IT teams to optimize device data capture, ultimately enhancing patient care and operational efficiency

 **Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**


For this role, candidates should possess foundational knowledge of healthcare IT systems, network protocols, and medical device terminology. Essential skills include strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, meticulous attention to detail for configuration and troubleshooting, and effective communication for collaborating with diverse teams. Additionally, the position requires the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently and the physical capacity to lift up to 50 lbs, which is often necessary for handling equipment.

 **Salary Range:**


Actual salary commensurate with experience.

Partial Remote, onsite as needed. Monday through Friday, 8 am to 5 pm, and as needed on occasion.

jobs.description:
Location: Memphis TN USA
Duration: 1 year
### **Location \& Work Requirements**


* **100% onsite in Memphis, TN** — no remote options.
* Must be a **U.S. Citizen or Green Card holder**.
* Must be flexible to work **weekends, holidays, and after\-hours** based on customer requirements.
* Strong verbal and written customer communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively within an onsite team in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

### **Hardware \& Field Support Experience**


The resource must be comfortable performing **hands\-on server hardware repair**. The role may include OSE/FSE support, so candidates must have practical experience working inside servers, replacing components, and performing hardware break/fix activities.


Candidates should be confident in their hands\-on technical abilities and capable of learning and applying new skills as required. **Prior Dell FSE experience is a strong plus.**


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Manage and track service tickets and requests.
* Provide day\-to\-day data center operational support.
* Escort and coordinate with dispatched field service engineers.
* Manage parts shipping, receiving, storage, and inventory.
* Maintain accurate environment documentation, including serial numbers, rack elevations, runbooks, and related records.
* Coordinate with colocation teams for power, cooling, and facility maintenance activities.
* Execute customer\-directed system and version updates.
* Proactively monitor servers and communicate issues to customers.
* Open, track, and manage service requests.
* Triage and coordinate break/fix activities with Dell support.
* Perform troubleshooting and log collection and implement vendor\-recommended resolutions.
* Support firmware upgrades and hardware break/fix activities.
* Perform server parts replacement and hardware deployments.
* Perform OS installations, GPU configuration, and related testing.
* Conduct system testing and validation to ensure operational readiness.
* Handle urgent or unexpected issues as they arise and serve as a flexible escalation and coordination point.

### **Required Skills**


* Basic networking experience.
* Experience reading and analyzing **Linux logs**.
* Hands\-on **Linux CLI** experience.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to lift up to **65 lbs.**
* Ability to safely work on a ladder.

### **Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Skills**


* **RoCE networking experience**.
* **NVIDIA GPU/NIC experience**.
* Prior **Dell FSE experience**.

### **Overall Candidate Profile**


The ideal candidate is a hands\-on data center professional with strong server hardware repair experience, Linux and networking fundamentals, excellent customer\-facing skills, and the flexibility to support onsite operations, including weekends, holidays, and after\-hours when required.
